start <- Sys.time()
set.seed(42)
design_matrix_base <- build_design_matrix_base_t()
design_matrix <- add_design_matrix_rows(design_matrix_base, 30)
# Assess clustering minimum p-value for an ordinal dependent variable
a <- execute_design_matrix(data_list, design_matrix, outcome_list)
b <- no_subs(a)
final <- b[, 2: length(b)] |>
    dplyr::mutate(nclust = case_when(
        eigen_or_rot == 1 ~ eigen_best,
        eigen_or_rot == 2 ~ rot_best),
        .keep = "unused") |>
    unique()
final_heat <- final |>
    dplyr::select(ends_with("_p"), -c("min_p_val", "mean_p_val")) |>
    sapply(as.numeric) |>
    as.matrix()
end <- Sys.time()
end - start
my_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("cyan", "deeppink3"))
heatmap(final_heat, col = rev(my_colors(100)))


png(file = "pilot_snf_pval_heatmap_corrected.png", width = 500, height = 700)
heatmap(final_heat, col = rev(my_colors(100)))
dev.off()

# The minimum p-value obtained:
min(final_heat)
